label: prf:torus-knot-genus-four-unique
title: Proof of torus knot genus four unique
html:
Proof. Proof of torus knot genus four unique

Proof. The Diophantine equation (m{-}1)(n{-}1) = 8 with 1 \leq m{-}1 \leq n{-}1 admits only the factorisations 8 = 1 \cdot 8 and 8 = 2 \cdot 4. The remaining 4 \cdot 2 and 8 \cdot 1 violate m \leq n or recover the listed solutions by the symmetry T_{m,n} \cong T_{n,m}. Coprimality \gcd(m,n) = 1 holds in both cases, so \{T_{2,9},\, T_{3,5}\} is the complete list of genus-4 torus knots up to mirror symmetry. \square
